title: Moninga Oyo Abalukaki
intro: Ozali pene ya kobimisa lisolo ya molimo moko oyo azalaki kofanda na elili ya boprofeta nzokande aponaki nzela oyo ememaki na libebi. Motango oyo akabolaki ndako na moko ya bamemi-nsango oyo Allah aponaki kasi alongaki te na momekano ya kondima. Moninga oyo abungi azali nani?
clues: Nazalaki kofanda kati na bato oyo baboyaki libiangi mpo na boyengebene, mpe natelemelaki bango te.
Nabalanaki na mosakoli moko ya Allah, kasi nazalaki na bindimeli yango te.
Ntango bamemi-nsango bayaki na ndako na ngai na likebisi, nandimaki bango te.
Molongani na ngai apesamaki mitindo ete abima na engumba elongo na bandimi, mpe nazalaki kati na bango te.
Etumbu ekita likolo ya bato ba ngai, mpe nabebisamaki elongo na bango.
Nalobelami na Coran lokola ndakisa ya kozanga kondima, pembeni ya mwasi ya Nuh, na Surah At-Tahrim.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: A trahir mobali na ye na kozanga kondima
A complot contre mission ya mobali na ye
Aboyaki kondima bosakoli ya mwana na ye
trial.answer: A trahir mobali na ye na kozanga kondima

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Abikisaki elongo na mobali na ye
Bamemaki bango na boombo na mboka moko ya mosika

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
